name: 60450 · Morris, IL
findings: ZIP 60450 (Morris) has 81 nonprofit organizations. 50 of them (62%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 39 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60450 (Morris) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 60450 (Morris) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.
